bookingOpens: Online only, through the restaurant's booking page; phone bookings are not taken. Card details are needed to confirm the booking, or it is turned down automatically.
groups: Weddings, company meetings and private events can be held in the Borgo Antico San Vitale, and the kitchen also caters at other venues; ask by email (info@duecolombe.com).
